source: Zeouf BRD v2.0 and QA guide at website commit df94db96826c3226abc77422d2234c7d3db92ea1

requirements.acceptance: Home shall show women/men hero content and matching links, with one active local video or still poster, manual slide selection and pause/play. Automatic change occurs about every six seconds while at least 10% visible, tab visible, unpaused and reduced motion disabled. Offscreen/hidden/paused media stops; reduced motion uses still imagery and manual selection.
requirements.qaFocus: Active-only playback, posters, manual selection, pause, offscreen/hidden tab, reduced motion

requirements.acceptance: Two collection panels, six editorial tiles and the blouse edit shall navigate to configured category/subcategory destinations. The seven-link shortcut row below the hero is visible only below 768px; desktop uses the header category navigation without a duplicate row. The compact homepage uses consistent typography/spacing and explicit demo copy; editorial tiles remain curated category links.
requirements.qaFocus: Every CTA/destination, 375/768/1440 widths, image loading

requirements.acceptance: Desktop navigation shall expose seven categories and women's/men's subcategory/highlight menus, with pointer hover and keyboard-operable expanded-state disclosure controls. Escape closes menus and restores focus to the corresponding disclosure button, including when a menu link holds focus; closed menu links are inert.
requirements.qaFocus: Hover, disclosure click/Enter, Escape from link/disclosure, trigger focus restoration, inert links, current route

requirements.acceptance: Mobile navigation shall open/close, expose seven category links and expandable women's/men's clothing/highlight sections, and close after navigation or Escape.
requirements.qaFocus: Touch, narrow screen, subcategories, dismissal and focus restoration

requirements.acceptance: Header shall expose account, search, favorites and cart; logo returns home. Desktop search/account/favorites/cart controls shall share a 40px height and vertically centered 19px icons; icon-only controls use 40px width, with account text allowed to expand the account control. Mobile keeps search/cart in the header and account/favorites in the menu. Active account/cart/search/mobile dialogs lock background scrolling, contain keyboard focus, and support Escape/close/backdrop dismissal with focus restoration; closed drawers are inert.
requirements.qaFocus: Dialog roles, Tab/Shift+Tab, Escape, counts, scroll lock, focus restoration

requirements.acceptance: English URLs and their legacy redirects/rewrites shall resolve to the intended page, including mapped legacy clothing slugs.
requirements.qaFocus: Direct URL, encoded query, redirect destination

requirements.acceptance: Unknown product/subcategory routes shall reach not-found; storefront chrome shall be absent from admin pages.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing ID, route refresh, admin layout

requirements.acceptance: Listings shall restrict products to the selected category/subcategory using configured English categories and normalized matching. Ordinary subcategory matches shall also require membership of the selected main collection, so /men/trousers excludes Women's Trousers and /men/jacket excludes Women's Jacket. Existing main-category normalization/aliases and new-arrivals, best-sellers and collection tag-route rules remain applicable to live and fallback catalogs.
requirements.qaFocus: All 14 database categories, mixed men's/women's trousers and jackets, alias/normalization cases, tag routes, live/fallback catalogs

requirements.acceptance: New Arrivals shall match tags containing new; Best Sellers shall match best/featured/populer tags; Collection shall include the main category. No sales ranking is implied.
requirements.qaFocus: Tags, main-category boundary, English/legacy slugs

requirements.acceptance: Brand and size filters shall use distinct values in the current collection and combine with other selected filters; missing option groups shall not show unusable selectors.
requirements.qaFocus: Single and combined filters, missing metadata

requirements.acceptance: Price filters shall apply inclusive displayed-currency min/max bounds through two sliders and suggested Under tiers; sliders shall not cross; currency changes clear price bounds.
requirements.qaFocus: Boundary prices, tier rounding, currency change

requirements.acceptance: In stock only shall keep unsized products with positive stock and sized products with available size stock; selected size shall constrain availability when stock rows exist.
requirements.qaFocus: Stock 0/1, mixed sizes, missing size rows

requirements.acceptance: Sort shall offer Recommended, Price Low to High, Price High to Low, and New Arrivals; listing price ties use name; New Arrivals prioritizes new tags then date then name. Recommended retains incoming order.
requirements.qaFocus: Equal price/date, missing date/tag

requirements.acceptance: Listing shall initially reveal at most 24 matches and load 24 more per click; count shall say Showing {visible} of {matching} products, following filters and the final batch. Changing brand, size, stock-only or either price bound, including clearing filters, shall reset the reveal limit to 24. After revealing all 49 products, applying a brand matching 30 shall show 24 cards, Showing 24 of 30 products and Load More; the next click reveals the remaining six and hides Load More. Pending requests show Loading collection, distinct from genuine empty collections and no-filter-match results.
requirements.qaFocus: Pending request, 0/1/24/25/48/49 products, count text, final batch, each filter reset, removing filters, clear all, 49-to-30 brand regression

requirements.acceptance: Listing shall use local products when Supabase is unconfigured or product fetch fails. Configured product and stock operations each have an eight-second deadline and cancel on cleanup. Product failure/timeout shows identified demo fallback and Retry collection; stock-only failure/timeout retains live products with availability warning and retry. Successful retry clears feedback; a successful empty product response stays empty. Fallback browsing does not establish working order/auth services.
requirements.qaFocus: Product/stock slow, error and empty responses; timeout, cancellation, retry, genuine empty versus demo fallback

requirements.acceptance: Header search shall focus its field, trim input, ignore empty submission, encode the query, close the search UI and navigate to /search?q=….
requirements.qaFocus: Spaces, ampersand, Unicode, keyboard submit

requirements.acceptance: Results shall combine case-insensitive name and category substring queries and deduplicate by product ID.
requirements.qaFocus: Name-only/category-only/both matches, case, no matches

requirements.acceptance: Search shall show loading, query/count, results, no-results and separate service-error states. Both name/category queries must succeed; rejected or hung requests reach Retry search within the eight-second operation deadline. Retry repeats the current query; query changes cancel prior work, blank/whitespace queries immediately hide old cards and show a prompt, and late responses cannot replace current results.
requirements.qaFocus: 503/network/timeout, retry, one failed branch, deduplication, rapid query changes, blank after results

requirements.acceptance: Cards/detail shall present name, price, image, optional brand/tag/category and product links; detail uses applicable gallery thumbnails. Cards and galleries use complete-photo contain framing with no forced zoom; demo detail frames are 2:3 portraits and cards retain their 3:4 layout. Responsive sizes cover detail and thumbnail placements. Cards show loading placeholders and retain readable product information with Image unavailable feedback after photo failure. Shared photo-source mapping applies to catalog/detail, saved bags, order/admin previews, assistant cards and Open Graph images.
requirements.qaFocus: Selected-card destination, exact product heading and detail controls, pending navigation/browser errors, single/multiple/missing images, supported remote host, loading/failure state

requirements.acceptance: Verified color options shall expose named swatches and applicable images; selected color accompanies cart line. Products under /demo-products/ shall hide colors and use one demo photograph.
requirements.qaFocus: Color/image correspondence, no-color/demo fixtures

requirements.acceptance: Sized products shall require a chosen available size before add. Zero or missing configured stock rows remain selectable for restock alerts, announce unavailable status and selection, and disable purchase/quantity increase. Detail initializes from supplied size_stock then refreshes database rows; missing rows count as zero. All-sold-out products offer whole-product alerts; selecting a sold-out size changes the alert to that exact size, and switching to an available size hides it.
requirements.qaFocus: No size, missing/zero row, mixed/all-zero configured sizes, keyboard selection, exact-size payload, switch back to available

requirements.acceptance: Detail quantity shall start at one, not decrease below one, clamp to known positive available stock, and disable add/increase when the known limit is reached.
requirements.qaFocus: 1, stock limit, size change, unknown stock

requirements.acceptance: Size guide shall open/close and show XS/S/M/L chest and waist references; it is a static clothing reference, not a product-specific shoe or XL/XXL guide.
requirements.qaFocus: Overlay dismissal and reference values

requirements.acceptance: Detail shall offer one-open-at-a-time information panels for details, measurements, composition/care/origin, and shipping/exchanges/returns. Product information uses supplied text or generic fallback; shipping content always states no charge, shipment, exchanges, returns or support follow-up and asks for fictional details, overriding any product shipping promises.
requirements.qaFocus: Open/switch/close, newline content, defaults, supplied shipping promises cannot override demo limits

requirements.acceptance: Complete Your Look shall show up to eight other products whose category starts with the main category; the current product is excluded and an empty related section is hidden.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/8 related items, links, horizontal scroll

requirements.acceptance: In-stock unsized cards shall allow Add to bag; sized cards link to size selection; out-of-stock cards display unavailable status and omit purchase controls. Actions are visible on touch layouts and reveal on hover or keyboard focus on desktop; favorite controls remain visible with pressed state.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized/out-of-stock, guest prompt, touch/keyboard/hover actions

requirements.acceptance: Dynamic routes in all seven category families shall generate product-specific titles identifying name/category with the root zeouf suffix, demo descriptions and Open Graph title/description/image when supplied. Recognized clothing subcategories get collection metadata; missing products request no indexing/following. Product lookup is memoized within a server render. Metadata does not enforce category-path ownership (G-08).
requirements.qaFocus: Seven product families, collection slugs, absent product, Open Graph values, category-path gap

requirements.acceptance: The demo photo library shall replace all 243 sub-900px legacy sources with standalone AI-enhanced 1024-by-1536 or larger 2:3 portrait WebP assets, retaining the 37 existing high-resolution demo photos and all originals. A manifest maps exact legacy URLs to versioned local URLs and records dimensions, checksums and illustrative provenance without changing product IDs/options/stock/prices or saved cart records. Enhanced detail imagery shall display Illustrative demo imagery. Unknown, original high-resolution and external sources pass through. The photo audit/build/CI shall reject missing, undersized or checksum-mismatched replacements; AI detail is illustrative, not verified merchandise evidence.
requirements.qaFocus: All mapped assets, complete cargo image at mobile/desktop, hover, saved legacy URLs, source preservation, new/original photos, image failure, provenance and visual review

requirements.acceptance: Storefront shall select USD for detected US country and INR for other countries; country headers take precedence over browser fallback (India time zone, America time zone, US language).
requirements.qaFocus: Header precedence, absent country, browser fallbacks

requirements.acceptance: USD display shall convert base INR through a valid positive rate, round to whole displayed units and use en-US formatting; INR uses rate one and en-IN. Rate fetch failure shall fall back to INR.
requirements.qaFocus: Invalid/zero rate, network failure, rounding

requirements.acceptance: Cart/detail/history shall use shared currency formatting; stored prices/order totals and admin monetary displays remain base INR. Conversion is presentation and does not establish USD settlement.
requirements.qaFocus: Base versus displayed totals, rate-dependent historical display

requirements.acceptance: Register shall collect required full name/email/password and call Supabase signup with name metadata; success switches to Sign In and explains email verification when applicable.
requirements.qaFocus: Required/email validation, duplicate signup, provider policy

requirements.acceptance: Controlled password confirmation shall match the exact password before Supabase signup. Blank confirmation is required; mismatch shows an alert and makes no create request. Confirmation clears on successful registration or account-tab change and is not sent to the provider.
requirements.qaFocus: Equal/unequal/blank confirmation, reveal toggle, request absence/payload, tab change

requirements.acceptance: Sign In shall authenticate email/password, display failure, show loading, and close account panel on session success; protected customer actions become available.
requirements.qaFocus: Valid/wrong/unverified/expired account, repeat submit

requirements.acceptance: Password visibility shall toggle in account forms without changing the entered password; Sign In/Register tabs shall be available.
requirements.qaFocus: Toggle, switch tab, stale feedback

requirements.acceptance: Forgot Password requires an entered email and requests a link to /reset-password with non-enumerating success copy. The recovery page verifies a Supabase user/session before offering new password and exact confirmation (8–128 characters in browser); mismatch makes no update. Provider errors preserve input; successful update clears passwords and signs out locally, with feedback if logout fails. Invalid/expired/missing sessions offer a fresh-link form; unconfigured fallback reports unavailable. Any verified current session can use this screen; it does not require a recovery-only token. Live email/redirect/provider policy remains G-02.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing email/config/session, expired/error links, mismatch, failed update/retry, success/signout, configured redirect/email

requirements.acceptance: Sign Out shall end the customer session, clear in-memory favorites and immediately empty/close the visible bag. A new account loads only its own browser bag; same-account token refresh preserves the bag. The signed-out account's scoped saved bag is retained for its next login on this browser.
requirements.qaFocus: Sign-out, direct account switch, reload, token refresh, former-account contents absent

requirements.acceptance: Browser registration shall use normal Supabase signup in every environment and shall never call the privileged dev create-user helper or receive its key. Confirmed development accounts may be created only through explicitly keyed nonproduction tooling; the helper remains disabled in production.
requirements.qaFocus: No helper browser requests, signup payload without confirmation, provider verification feedback, unconfigured signup, keyed local tooling

requirements.acceptance: Signed-in customers shall toggle a product favorite from card/detail; stored user/product pair is unique and successful changes update icon/count.
requirements.qaFocus: Toggle/add/remove, duplicate click, failed write

requirements.acceptance: Favorites shall load for the current user and clear on sign-out; one customer must not read/change another customer's favorites.
requirements.qaFocus: Two-account isolation, reload, direct database access

requirements.acceptance: Favorites page shall display saved product cards/count, loading, and empty Discover Collection link; visitors attempting to favorite shall get an account prompt.
requirements.qaFocus: Empty/deleted product, guest prompt, card navigation

requirements.acceptance: Add shall require a current customer session; a visitor receives an account prompt without addition. CartContext returns whether an addition was accepted, rejects an optional expected-account mismatch and invalid/overflowing quantities, and opens the drawer only on success. The interrupted action is not automatically replayed after login.
requirements.qaFocus: Guest/customer, stale account, accepted/refused outcome, quantity overflow, post-login retry

requirements.acceptance: Lines shall be identified by product ID + size + color; missing/empty/null options normalize to null. Matching tuples merge quantities and differing options create distinct lines, including recovered legacy lines.
requirements.qaFocus: Same/different options, null/missing color, repeated add, legacy restoration

requirements.acceptance: Drawer shall show image/name/options/quantity/line total; plus/minus updates quantity; a quantity below one or explicit remove deletes the line.
requirements.qaFocus: Remove at one, variant-specific deletion, total changes

requirements.acceptance: Cart persistence shall use els-cart:{encoded customer ID}, restore only after auth resolution and write with the owner captured at mutation time. Sign-out clears visible items and closes the drawer; account switch restores the new owner only. The unowned legacy els-cart key is removed with a re-add notice and never assigned to an account. Malformed JSON/nonarrays recover to empty; invalid rows are discarded with feedback while valid rows and normalized variants survive. Restored fields require supported photo URLs, finite nonnegative numeric prices and positive safe-integer quantities. Storage failures preserve separate in-memory account bags with a persistence notice. No database or cross-device cart sync and no automatic guest-action replay exist.
requirements.qaFocus: Auth startup, A/sign-out/B/A, refresh, legacy bag, malformed rows, quota/read failure, writes during auth changes

requirements.acceptance: Item badge equals sum of quantities; base subtotal equals sum of stored line price × quantity, displayed through currency formatter. Checkout determines authoritative current prices.
requirements.qaFocus: Multiple lines, rounding, changed database price

requirements.acceptance: Empty drawer shall show Start Shopping; nonempty drawer shall show Proceed to Checkout and close when navigating; cart UI currently has no upper quantity cap.
requirements.qaFocus: Empty/nonempty, close, quantity above API limit

requirements.acceptance: Submission shall require a verified customer bearer token and nonempty cart. UI enables form entry only after a customer account is restored, follows the cart owner, rejects a changed session before dispatch, and clears entered contact fields/confirmation on owner change. Late responses from a previous account shall not display that account's confirmation or clear the current account's bag. Server rejects invalid/expired sessions.
requirements.qaFocus: Guest, expired token, forged user ID, empty cart, account switch before dispatch and during response

requirements.acceptance: All five shipping fields shall be nonempty after server trimming: full name, phone, address, city, postal code; current server truncation limits in section 7 apply.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing/whitespace fields, limits, numeric-looking strings

requirements.acceptance: Request shall contain 1–50 raw item entries with strict UUID product IDs and integer quantities 1–20 after Number conversion; duplicate tuples merge and merged quantity above 20 fails. Nonstring or oversized size/color values fail before the transaction.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/50/51 lines, invalid UUID, quantity 0/1/20/21/fraction, duplicates, option type/length

requirements.acceptance: Checkout shall offer demo card and simulated cash on delivery, clearly state no charge/delivery, and collect/send no card details. Card adds a roughly 1.2-second simulation delay and is labelled Simulated successful payment; no charge; no decline branch exists. Historical G-11 is retained.
requirements.qaFocus: Both methods, request payload, no card details or approval/decline claim

requirements.acceptance: The authoritative database transaction shall use current database price snapshots and available inventory, ignoring browser-supplied prices/totals. Sized products require configured size stock; colors share that stock. There is no separate API inventory precheck.
requirements.qaFocus: Price tampering, stale price, removed product, missing stock row

requirements.acceptance: A new successful transaction shall create one pending order and all lines with quantity, unit price, size/color; decrement inventory and set total to sum of snapshots. Sized totals sum only currently configured size rows; obsolete rows do not inflate stock.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized/multi-line transactions, shared color stock, stale size rows

requirements.acceptance: Insufficient stock in the transaction shall return 409; failure shall leave no partial order/lines/attempt record or stock decrement. Product rows are locked in UUID order before writes, with guarded decrements. Competing orders must not oversell; multi-session concurrency remains unverified by the single-connection local suite.
requirements.qaFocus: Last unit concurrency, crossed multi-product orders, later-line rollback, DB failure

requirements.acceptance: On successful returned order ID for the still-current account, UI shall clear that account's bag and show demo confirmation/ID and Continue Shopping with no delivery/email/support promises. API failure, malformed response or network rejection shall show error, keep cart and release submitting state for retry. A synchronous guard prevents overlapping submissions; late prior-account responses cannot clear another bag or show its order ID.
requirements.qaFocus: Success, malformed/error response, network rejection, repeated click, retained retry state, account race

requirements.acceptance: Purchase safeguards transaction shall enforce configured size and color: sized products require a listed size; unsized products reject size; non-demo products with color options require a listed color; demo-photo/no-color products reject color. A UUID Idempotency-Key is required. The same customer/key/normalized payload returns the original order and total before stock checks; changed payload returns 409 without writes. Different customers cannot replay each other's order. Applied/live behavior remains unverified (G-08, G-14).
requirements.qaFocus: Missing/invented option, absent/malformed key, exact replay after depletion, changed items/address/payment, cross-customer keys

requirements.acceptance: Browser checkout shall retain a random attempt UUID and SHA-256 digest of customer/items/address/method under zeouf-checkout-attempt in sessionStorage, storing no raw contact fields there. Same details after a lost response/reload reuse the key; changed fingerprint generates a new key. Success removes it; unavailable storage permits in-memory retry only. Reload requires re-entering the same form details, and a new tab/session is not a guaranteed replay.
requirements.qaFocus: Both methods, lost response/reload, unchanged/changed details, account switch, blocked storage, success cleanup, no raw contact storage

requirements.acceptance: Customers shall retrieve only their own orders, newest first, including order lines; guest, loading, error and no-order states shall be distinct.
requirements.qaFocus: Two-account ownership, direct reads, empty/error

requirements.acceptance: Order cards shall show short ID, date, formatted total and demo status; expanding one order shows product/image, quantity, line total and demo payment label, including Simulated cash on delivery. Introductory copy states no charge or delivery.
requirements.qaFocus: Expand/collapse, deleted product fallback, all statuses, demo copy/payment labels

requirements.acceptance: Saved size/color snapshots shall render on expanded customer order lines and admin order details when present, with deleted-product fallback. Admin detail also shows saved address/contact fields and demo payment method; historical absent fields use fallback copy.
requirements.qaFocus: Present/missing variants/address/method, reload, deleted product

requirements.acceptance: Review form requires a nonblank display name of at most 120 trimmed characters, comment and integer stars 1–5. Verified bearer server creation stores the trimmed supplied name with pending product/user/rating/comment and optional owned private image paths. Workflow migration adds missing name/reply columns; historical names cannot be reconstructed. Direct customer writes remain denied.
requirements.qaFocus: Blank/oversized name, guest, rating bounds, owned paths, pending stored name, missing migration

requirements.acceptance: Review upload accepts 1–3 JPEG/PNG/WebP files of 1 byte–2 MiB each for an authenticated user and existing product, checks signatures, and limits each account to ten upload requests/day. New private review-images paths are validated against product/user ownership before ten-minute signed URLs are returned to moderators or public approved-review readers. Historical public files, signed-link access until expiry after unpublishing and orphan cleanup remain limits.
requirements.qaFocus: File boundaries, ownership, private bucket, signed expiry, unpublish/deletion access window, historical cleanup

requirements.acceptance: Submission keeps form data during upload/save, shows an error on failure, and clears it only after server creation. A successful pending review is acknowledged as awaiting approval and is not placed in the public list.
requirements.qaFocus: Successful pending response, upload/API/network failure, retry/data retention

requirements.acceptance: Public GET /api/reviews and product detail show up to 100 newest approved rows only, including saved names/replies and signed owned photos when service-role signing is configured. Public responses omit user IDs and raw stored paths; without a service role displayImages is empty. Detail uses an eight-second request limit and Retry reviews feedback on failure. Database allows approved reads or author-owned pending reads and denies customer writes; live migration/visibility remain G-04.
requirements.qaFocus: Approved-only, safe public fields, 100-row cap, no-service photos, failure/retry/timeout, live role checks

requirements.acceptance: Cookie-authenticated admins shall approve, unpublish and delete reviews through protected server routes. Approval/unpublishing records moderator/time and updates approved aggregates. Mutations reject cross-site/origin mismatches and share 60 changes/admin/minute with unavailable production limiter failing closed. Missing reviews return 404, invalid updates 400/413, limited changes 429 and unavailable storage/configuration 503. Deletion retains private attachments.
requirements.qaFocus: Cookie/origin/limit denial, missing ID, aggregate changes, error/retry, retained attachments

requirements.acceptance: Direct /admin/reviews and the Reviews sidebar shall use the same queue, loading up to 200 latest reviews via status=all and filtering pending/approved/all locally. API accepts pending (default), approved or all and rejects unknown statuses. Queue shows errors/refresh and confirms deletion. Legacy approve/delete form routes redirect to /admin/reviews with 303 after success and retain safe JSON errors on failure.
requirements.qaFocus: Both entry paths, filters/caps, failure/refresh, deletion confirmation, legacy redirects

requirements.acceptance: Admins shall save trimmed replies of 1–2000 characters or remove them with null through cookie-protected PATCH. Server records replied_at or clears it; approval/reply are the only accepted fields. Failed saves retain drafts and report failure; only persisted updates show success. Public replies appear only with approved reviews. Workflow migration supplies name/admin_reply/replied_at; applied environment remains unverified.
requirements.qaFocus: Whitespace/length/unknown fields, save/remove/reload, failed draft retention, public approval boundary

requirements.acceptance: Guests or customers may request an unavailable product or selected unavailable size. The service-only subscription RPC locks the parent product, validates configured size/color (demo-photo products reject color), rejects currently available requests with 409, and atomically saves normalized email/options/token. Missing configured size rows count as unavailable. Invalid bodies/email/options fail, unknown product is 404, and unavailable service/migration is 503.
requirements.qaFocus: Whole product versus exact size, missing row, in-stock rejection, configured/demo colors, malformed body, guest, subscription versus stock race

requirements.acceptance: Subscription shall trim/lowercase email and atomically reuse the exact pending product/email/size/color tuple, returning already_subscribed. The partial unique index and INSERT ON CONFLICT prevent concurrent duplicates. Email underscores/percent signs are literal characters, not wildcard matching. A completed request may later subscribe again only when unavailable.
requirements.qaFocus: Case/whitespace, null options, literal wildcard characters, duplicate races, resubscribe after depletion

requirements.acceptance: Response/UI shall distinguish saved-with-mail-enabled from saved-with-mail-disabled. Missing mail configuration leaves requests unclaimed and pending; configured sends require a public site URL. Admin processing reports provider acceptance, failures and saved requests separately from stock-save success.
requirements.qaFocus: Mail on/off, missing database/site URL, queued response, stock saved but mail failed

requirements.acceptance: Database triggers shall queue pending alerts only on genuine zero-to-positive stock changes: exact configured size, whole-product when any configured size first returns, or unsized stock. Repeated positive saves and obsolete rows do not create eligibility. Service-only workers claim up to ten due eligible alerts with product-first locking, SKIP LOCKED and a ten-minute lease. Claim and preparation both recheck live size/color/inventory and unsubscribe deletion; successful provider acceptance marks notified only for the matching claim token. No stock is reserved and availability may change after preparation.
requirements.qaFocus: Exact/whole size, missing/retired options, repeated saves, depletion before send, over-100 backlog, lease recovery/stale completion, cancellation restoration

requirements.acceptance: GET/POST token unsubscribe shall delete the matching alert and return plain confirmation; malformed token fails, well-formed already-removed token is still successful; public clients cannot directly read the alert table. Deletion cancels an unsent queue claim, but cannot recall an email already in flight.
requirements.qaFocus: Valid/repeated/malformed token, privacy/RLS

requirements.acceptance: Delivery shall persist the exact first payload and use stable restock/request-ID provider idempotency. Transient failures retry with 60-second exponential backoff capped at one hour; leases recover crashes and missing acknowledgements. Permanent provider errors and attempts older than 23 hours park for operator reconciliation before Resend's 24-hour deduplication expires. Signed-admin processing or a bearer-protected scheduler POST drains ten due alerts per call; no live scheduler is provisioned by application code. A valid separate RESTOCK_CRON_SECRET of at least 32 characters is required. Provider acceptance is not proof of inbox delivery.
requirements.qaFocus: Fake timeout/429/5xx/permanent error, frozen payload, duplicate key, failed acknowledgement, expired retry window, scheduler auth, disabled config and staging delivery

requirements.acceptance: Admin login in every environment requires a named account with its scrypt password hash and a distinct session-signing secret of at least 32 characters; it issues a one-hour HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax cookie, Secure in production. The browser collects username/password. DEV_CREATE_USER_KEY shall never substitute for admin credentials or cookie signing; missing admin configuration returns 503 and missing/short signing secrets cannot sign or verify cookies. MFA and live credential provisioning remain open.
requirements.qaFocus: Wrong username/password, missing development/production config, helper-key denial, short/missing signing secret, cookie claims/attributes, MFA gap

requirements.acceptance: Catalog reads/saves/deletes/uploads and review moderation/replies shall require a signed admin cookie independent of local UI flags. Server service-role writes use validated routes and same-origin mutation guards; browser catalog/image/review writes are restricted by current migrations. Applied live role/storage permissions remain G-06.
requirements.qaFocus: Forged/expired/customer cookies, cross-site writes, service-only RPCs/storage, review replies and live grants

requirements.acceptance: Sidebar logout shall POST the cookie-clearing endpoint and wait for success before removing the local flag and replacing the route with /admin. Failed requests preserve the session and display retry feedback. After successful logout the same browser's protected APIs deny access. This clears the browser cookie; copied signed tokens retain their original expiry.
requirements.qaFocus: Cookie/flag after sidebar logout, API rejection, request failure/retry, endpoint contracts

requirements.acceptance: Dashboard shall show product/configured-stock/out-of-stock/low-stock counts including unsized low stock, up to five newest orders, inventory warning and quick links. Refresh/retry shall reload catalog/stock and orders; failed/loading inventory metrics show an unavailable dash and failed order reads do not show a successful empty state. Add a product shall open its form.
requirements.qaFocus: Known sized/unsized counts, newest five, failed reads versus empty, refresh, working Add product

requirements.acceptance: Dashboard shall show a pending-order count linking to the pending queue and active demo order value excluding cancelled orders, with explicit no-payment-collected copy. Failed/loading order metrics show an unavailable dash.
requirements.qaFocus: Pending-queue navigation, mixed status/value fixtures, unavailable states, demo copy

requirements.acceptance: Admin product table shall load products with configured size rows through signed-cookie GET /api/admin/products, newest first, and combine case-insensitive name search with exact category filter. Failed reads show actionable feedback rather than a successful empty catalog.
requirements.qaFocus: Cookie/503 failures, search/category/no matches, nested inventory, refresh

requirements.acceptance: Add/edit shall persist validated name/category/price/description/sizes/main image/image list through server-only catalog routes and save_admin_product. Initial unsized stock can be supplied on create; existing quantities are changed only on Stock Management. Failed writes keep the form and values, release saving state and show a safe error.
requirements.qaFocus: Create/edit/reload, denied writes, retained fields, retry, stale metadata form versus checkout

requirements.acceptance: Server product saves shall require a trimmed name of 1-200 characters, configured category, finite numeric price 0 to less than 10000000000 with at most two decimals, numeric integer stock 0-2147483647, description at most 10000 characters, unique configured sizes and at most 12 image URLs. Images accept local root paths or HTTPS on the configured Supabase origin, never executable/protocol-relative URLs. JSON body above 50000 JavaScript characters gives 413. Database price/stock checks enforce future writes; NOT VALID preserves legacy rows for explicit inspection/repair (G-17).
requirements.qaFocus: NaN/string/negative/fraction/overflow, duplicate/unknown size/category, URL/malformed/body boundaries, legacy invalid rows

requirements.acceptance: Product image upload shall use signed-cookie, same-origin server POST /api/admin/products/upload with shared limit 10/admin/minute; choose one 1-byte to 2-MiB JPEG/PNG/WebP file with matching signature. Declared Content-Length above 3 MiB gives 413. Server generates a UUID path in public product-images; storage bucket has matching size/type limits and restrictive browser-write guards. Upload failures show feedback; Save/Upload are disabled during upload. Removing a URL or abandoning a form does not delete stored objects.
requirements.qaFocus: Anonymous/cross-site denial, size/type/signature, failed upload, public URL, max images, signature-not-full-decode and multipart limits

requirements.acceptance: Atomic catalog save shall lock the parent product before size rows, preserving retained-size quantities, inserting new configured sizes at zero, deleting removed/obsolete rows and deriving sized total from current rows. Client overall stock cannot override a sized total or an existing unsized quantity. Removing all sizes starts unsized stock at zero. This shares checkout/stock lock order; live multi-session verification and separate seed-insert repair remain G-18.
requirements.qaFocus: Retain/add/remove/missing/obsolete rows, sized-to-unsized, stale form after depletion, forced rollback, live concurrency

requirements.acceptance: Delete shall require browser confirmation and signed-cookie server DELETE /api/admin/products/[id]. Missing product gives 404; failed writes show feedback and retain the list. Database cascades dependent favorite/review/size/alert rows; historical order lines retain price/quantity with null product. Stored image files are not garbage-collected.
requirements.qaFocus: Cancel/confirm, missing ID, denial/error, referenced product/history snapshots, image retention

requirements.acceptance: Stock view shall expose one row per configured size or one Overall row for unsized products. Whole-number nonnegative edits save on blur through protected stock PATCH; failed writes/invalid values show feedback without updating in-memory stock. Positive saves can request processing of database-eligible alerts, with separate delivery feedback. Process due alerts drains a batch independently of a stock edit.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized, blur, failed write, expired cookie, saved stock with failed mail, retry control

requirements.acceptance: Cookie-protected stock API shall require a strict UUID and Number-converted integer stock 0–2147483647, rejecting nonstring nonnull sizes. set_product_stock shall lock the product, validate size membership, upsert the size and sum only configured rows, or set unsized overall stock. Unknown product returns 404; invalid option 400; absent service config 503; RPC/migration failure 500.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/4/5, negative/fraction/overflow, invalid UUID/type, unknown product, missing/existing/stale row

requirements.acceptance: Row labels shall be Out of stock for zero, Low stock for 1-4, Available for 5+. Dashboard and analytics low-stock counts include unsized products with 1-4 units and sized products with at least one configured size in that range.
requirements.qaFocus: 0/1/4/5, unsized low stock, configured size versus obsolete rows

requirements.acceptance: Purchase stock RPC and atomic catalog save shall use parent-product-first locking with checkout. Stock RPC rejects unsupported size or overall edits on sized products; catalog save synchronizes configured rows/totals and preserves current existing unsized stock. Local rollback/permission tests are scoped evidence; separate seeding and live multi-session behavior remain G-18.
requirements.qaFocus: Transaction failure, checkout/edit concurrency, configured aggregate, stale form, seed-repair limitation

requirements.acceptance: Admin shall retrieve orders/lines newest first through authenticated API; table shall show ID/customer ID/INR total/status/date and View action.
requirements.qaFocus: All versus own orders, expired cookie, retrieval failure

requirements.acceptance: Order search shall match order ID or customer ID case-insensitively and combine with exact status filter, distinguishing no orders from no matches.
requirements.qaFocus: Partial ID, casing, all five statuses

requirements.acceptance: View shall open a native modal dialog showing customer, products, quantities, saved size/color, totals, saved shipping/contact address and demo payment method. Escape/Close restores trigger focus. Only current and permitted next statuses are offered, terminal selectors are disabled and updates block duplicates. Failed status changes remain visible without claiming success; successful cancellation refreshes inventory.
requirements.qaFocus: Keyboard/focus, present/missing fields, allowed statuses, failed update, cancellation inventory refresh

requirements.acceptance: Service-only set_admin_order_status shall allow pending→processing/cancelled, processing→shipped/cancelled, shipped→delivered; delivered/cancelled are terminal. Repeating the current status is idempotent. Order/product locking makes pre-shipment cancellation restore configured size or unsized quantities once and set stock_restored_at. Missing/deleted products are skipped; incompatible changed size configuration aborts all restoration/status writes with 409. Historic already-cancelled rows are not retroactively restocked. Invalid transitions return 409, absent order 404, unavailable RPC 503; API mutations require same origin and 60 changes/admin/minute. Live concurrency/application remain G-19.
requirements.qaFocus: Forward/backward/terminal/repeated changes, shared colors, unsized/configured totals, atomic rollback, deleted/historical rows, privileges and live races

requirements.acceptance: Admin users list shall retrieve at most 200 profiles ordered by updated_at, presenting ID/full name/update time; endpoint shall reject non-admin access.
requirements.qaFocus: No profiles, cap 200/201, permissions

requirements.acceptance: User View shall open a read-only native modal with full name, ID and profile update time. Escape/Close restores focus; View customer orders closes the dialog and selects Orders with that exact customer ID in search. Profile failures show Retry users. Email/edit/disable/delete are unsupported.
requirements.qaFocus: Dialog focus/keyboard/fallbacks, customer search, failed reads/retry, read-only boundary

requirements.acceptance: Analytics shall show active demo order value and active order count excluding cancelled orders, average active order value (zero when empty), and configured stock units in INR/base values. Failed/loading data shows an unavailable dash for its summary metrics. These are demo order values, not collected revenue. Pipeline still includes all five statuses.
requirements.qaFocus: Known active/cancelled totals, zero orders, failed reads, average denominator, demo labels

requirements.acceptance: Order pipeline shall show count and rounded percent for each of five statuses; rounding need not sum to exactly 100%.
requirements.qaFocus: Empty and uneven status distribution

requirements.acceptance: Inventory health shall show healthy=max(products−low−out,0), low/out counts and units derived from configured sizes or unsized stock.
requirements.qaFocus: Sized/unsized low counts, inconsistent stored rows

requirements.qaFocus: Ties, deleted product, cancelled exclusion, no active sales

requirements.qaFocus: Mixed approvals, 0/1/multiple approved, failed read, correct denominator

requirements.acceptance: Settings shall show a read-only identity/catalog summary and status of the latest protected catalog request: checking, succeeded or unavailable with dashboard retry guidance. This is not a database-wide health probe; no configuration save or feature toggles exist.
requirements.qaFocus: Successful/failed/loading protected request, honest read-only/status copy

requirements.acceptance: Footer newsletter shall identify Newsletter preview and state no save/subscription/send before entry. Labelled email field uses browser email validation; Try preview displays no-save/no-send feedback and sends no subscription request.
requirements.qaFocus: Pre-submit limits, accessible label/description, invalid/valid email, no network subscription/write

requirements.qaFocus: All destinations and external link attributes

requirements.acceptance: Home/checkout/privacy/terms/footer/history/detail shall explain demo limits and stored demo data. No charge, shipment, returns or support follow-up is promised; fictional details are requested. Privacy describes approved review names/photos/replies, private signed photos and attachment retention, plus page-memory chat/preferences, reset behavior and possible recent-message/current-preference/catalog transmission to the AI provider. Page-memory limits do not establish provider retention. Attribution/license inconsistency remains G-22.
requirements.qaFocus: Content consistency, fictional data, approved photos/names/replies, expiry/retention, attribution gap

requirements.acceptance: Holiday countdown component exists but is not mounted by current pages; enabling it needs scope confirmation. It counts to local-browser 31 Dec 2026 23:59:59, clamps at zero, and applies no discount.
requirements.qaFocus: Exclude from current UI pass criteria; future timer tests

requirements.qaFocus: JSON and timestamp, no inferred DB health

requirements.qaFocus: Production 404, wrong secret 401, partial reset

requirements.qaFocus: New/existing user, missing fields, auth/production

Nonproduction requires a configured nonblank DEV_CREATE_USER_KEY (otherwise 503) and matching x-dev-key (otherwise 401) before processing input or accessing Supabase. The helper caps counted dev_auto users at ten and shall not overwrite non-dev accounts. Its key is server-only and separate from admin credentials/signing.
requirements.qaFocus: Production with/without key, missing/blank configured key, missing/wrong request key, authorized input validation, limit boundary, existing dev/non-dev

requirements.qaFocus: Schema available/missing, clipboard failure

requirements.acceptance: Requirements CI shall run the checked-in synchronization regression tests. Build and lint shall reject stale derived documentation, unreviewed tracked website source, or a mismatched review snapshot/log. All four browser configurations, including playwright.assistant.config.ts, require source review. requirements.qaFocus: Missing snapshot, source drift, assistant config coverage, CSV manual evidence, retired IDs, repeated sync, review assertions

requirements.acceptance: UI/admin, catalog and assistant Chromium suites run sequentially on dedicated servers with disabled live Supabase service-role/mail/model credentials, no server reuse, separate artifacts and isolated compilation output. ISOLATED_BROWSER_TESTS=1 disables persistent Turbopack development caching to avoid stale HMR output across changed fixture configurations/source; ordinary development and production cache settings retain defaults. Catalog/assistant browser fixtures intercept reserved .invalid Supabase domains; tool tests use injected stores or fallback data. Fictional sessions exercise auth notifications without real accounts. Mocks/local cookies are not live acceptance.
requirements.qaFocus: Disabled live services, fresh fixture compilation after source/config change, sequential suites, artifacts/review

requirements.acceptance: npm run test:live shall run optional Chromium public-browsing checks against the deployed Vercel origin, with PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL accepting another HTTP(S) origin without credentials/path/query/fragment. No local server is launched or authenticated storage reused. The suite checks homepage, seven populated collections without fallback warnings, search, product detail, mobile navigation, information pages and admin login rendering. It blocks mutating HTTP methods and known helper/logout paths, and fails attempted writes. It does not authenticate, submit commerce/customer/admin changes or establish their acceptance. Artifacts use test-results/live; live checks remain separate from deployment-racing push CI.
requirements.qaFocus: Correct target, no local startup, public data available, state-changing requests blocked, separate artifacts and acceptance limits

requirements.acceptance: Read-only npm run security:check-db with explicit DATABASE_URL shall inspect review/order/limiter RLS/grants plus current five-argument checkout, stock/catalog service-only RPCs, removed legacy RPC, private attempts, browser catalog write denial, product-image bucket/guards and legacy invalid price/stock rows. Shared catalog-inspector queries are exercised in isolated PostgreSQL, including a permission regression. Full applied Supabase verification remains pending; G-25 history is retained.
requirements.qaFocus: Missing URL/migrations, current signatures, private attempts, table/column grants, storage guards, legacy invalid rows, no writes

requirements.acceptance: test:purchase applies base, checkout security, demo catalog, purchase safeguards, admin catalog, order lifecycle and review workflow migrations to isolated PGlite with minimal auth/storage fixtures. Twenty-six cases cover replay/options/rollback/totals, catalog synchronization/grants, lifecycle forward/idempotent transitions, cancellation restoration/rollback/deleted/historical products, service-only permissions and migration reapply. Single-connection mocked storage does not prove live Auth/Storage or concurrent sessions.
requirements.qaFocus: 26 scoped cases, no live mutations, role/rollback/reapply assertions, live concurrency remains separate

requirements.acceptance: npm run audit:storefront collects a read-only unauthenticated Chromium/axe report at desktop/390px/320px widths for configured origin/paths, defaulting to the public storefront. It blocks attempted mutations/helpers/logout, records accessibility flags, overflow, image sizing and unthrottled lab timing. Strict mode fails errors/non-200/writes/overflow/axe findings; collection without strict is not a passing quality test. Reports use test-results/quality/storefront-audit.json.
requirements.qaFocus: Origin/path validation, guarded reads, strict failure, report scope; no field performance or WCAG conformance claim

requirements.acceptance: Every non-admin page shows a bottom-right Ask Zeouf launcher opening a non-modal panel named Zeouf Shopping Assistant. Warm neutral surfaces, wine/brown accents, editorial typography, a product/size/bag welcome and icon suggestions match the store. AI-answer warning and privacy reminder stay visible in the footer. Escape closes and restores launcher focus; opening focuses input; Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline and IME composition does not submit. Messages are escaped, duplicate sends blocked and errors offer applicable Retry. Visible For this conversation chips show active preferences; Clear preferences removes filters while retaining chat. New conversation clears preferences/chat/comparisons/pending work and returns the log to the welcome top. Confirm success offers View bag, closing chat and opening the existing drawer.
requirements.qaFocus: Welcome/copy/privacy, focus/keyboard/IME, mobile layout, escaped HTML, retry/reset/top position, View bag, no admin launcher

requirements.acceptance: POST /api/assistant shall keep GROQ_API_KEY server-side, use Groq Responses API with default openai/gpt-oss-20b or nonblank GROQ_MODEL, and limit each address to 10 requests/minute. No OpenAI credential fallback or automatic SDK retries; each provider call times out after 25 seconds. One 35-second server deadline covers body, limiter, auth, catalog and every model round; confirmation has a 10-second server deadline. Disconnect/deadline cancels supported provider/auth/catalog/limiter fetches, settles waits and prevents subsequent rounds; cancelled/timed-out requests return safe 504 responses when connected. It accepts 1–50 messages, validates/processes only the last 12, each trimmed to nonblank text of at most 1,000 characters with user/assistant roles and a final user message. Raw body length above 24,000 JavaScript characters gives 413, not a measured byte limit. Optional preferences follow AST-14 and comparison output follows AST-13; malformed preference state gives 400 before model configuration is checked. The 24000-character cap includes preference state. Missing key for valid free-text chat or unavailable production limiter gives 503; valid card interactions need no key. Supported referenced questions/refinements/comparisons can use deterministic tools without an SDK call, but free-text requests still require configured chat credentials. Address/provider quota gives safe 429; other model failures give 502.
requirements.qaFocus: SDK URL/auth/signal/model, complete-operation deadline, hanging auth/catalog, disconnect/no late rounds, keyless actions, quota/no retries, shape/history/body boundaries, production limiter

requirements.acceptance: Tools shall read catalog facts, validate arguments and label authored text untrusted. Category filters match whole names or prefixes/aliases, never men inside womens. Search uses whole words, common plurals and pants/trousers/slacks aliases; short-sleeve/sleeved is a top attribute, not shorts. A checked-in product-type/family vocabulary limits typed searches to compatible garments and known audience; sibling-type alternatives must share a distinguishing identity keyword when one was requested. Description-only hits cannot admit an otherwise irrelevant product. Exact results require all query keywords in identity fields plus compatible product type; exact results exclude partial matches. No exact result gives query-specific missing-match/similar-product copy; no relevant candidate gives empty/filter guidance. Validated conversation choices override conflicting model search filters. Explicit category/audience, budget, size, color, material, fit and stock constraints remain enforced. Color discovery accepts configured options or whole color words in product names (gray/grey normalized); it never creates selectable variants. Material/fit use catalog-topic excerpts or explicitly labelled name hints. Bounded exclusions remove listed matches and do not certify absence of unlisted attributes. Related actions also retain the active query/budget/attribute constraints; no-result responses never silently relax them. Similar cards may include server-composed matchReason describing shared keywords and different garment type. Search/related return at most eight; free-text replies display the server's top three in ranked order, including an empty result, regardless of model markers or earlier lookups. Related results stay in the base product's family/known audience and prefer the same type/category over brand-only overlap. Model selection still applies to nonranked detail lookups with invented IDs dropped. Configured-size stock rules reject missing/duplicate/retired rows and requested-size searches check that size; demo products suppress colors like checkout. Raw model prose is never factual output. Prompt preserves requested keywords/filters; cached recommendations (30 seconds), finite vocabulary and real-provider routing remain G-26.
requirements.qaFocus: Real seeded cargo shorts versus short-sleeve shirts, exact/sibling/empty results, audience boundaries, aliases, preserved filters, related-family relevance, model reorder/old-card rejection, size stock, malicious text, cache/live limits

requirements.acceptance: getCart shall require a verified customer bearer token, accept up to 30 valid browser-supplied lines and price them from catalog data (cached normally; fresh snapshot for referenced follow-ups). Lines/totals render deterministically in display currency with INR base values. Anonymous/invalid tokens receive sign-in-required output. The UI supplies the active account's scoped browser bag; it remains client-supplied data rather than a database-owned cart or purchase authority. Identity isolation follows AST-07; no order/account/checkout/payment tools exist.
requirements.qaFocus: Verified token, tampered price, totals, fresh references, removed products, account switch, scoped bag

requirements.acceptance: addToCart shall propose without mutating after a verified session, intent flag and keyword heuristic; listed options and quantity 1-10 use cached stock including bag quantities across colors sharing the same product/size. Card Review bag addition submits explicit selected options through the same tool without a model. Confirm calls POST /api/assistant/confirm with bearer token, INR proposal price/options/quantity and up to 30 valid cart lines. Server identity and fresh uncached validation reject removed products 404, changed price/options or insufficient combined stock 409, invalid payload 400/413, missing identity 401, address limit 429 and unavailable limiter/stock 503; cancellation/deadline returns 504. It saves nothing and reserves no stock. Client session/cart checks and duplicate prevention mark Sent to your bag only after CartContext accepts the addition for the expected account. Checkout remains authoritative (G-26).
requirements.qaFocus: Selected options, fresh identity/price/stock checks, INR under USD display, combined bag stock, timeout/retry/double click, actual cart outcome, no reservation

requirements.acceptance: Store-policy tool, deterministic reply and prompt shall match portfolio-demo copy: no charges, shipment/delivery, shipping services, exchanges, returns or support follow-up. Demo card and simulated cash on delivery are available; fictional contact details are requested. Policy answers render the checked-in policy summaries, never model-generated commercial promises. Unknown/failed/no-tool topics use safe notices/fallbacks. No delivery dates, discounts or order lookup are provided.
requirements.qaFocus: Exact policy facts, malicious generated claims suppressed, unknown/no-tool fallback; live topic/tool selection remains unverified

requirements.acceptance: Widget conversations, reference IDs, failed retry history, preferences, comparisons, proposals and confirmation flags reset on identity change; same-account token refresh preserves chat. Reset/unmount cancels browser requests and ignores older-generation responses. Outgoing history is capped to the last 12 entries with at most 1,000 characters each; browser waits end after 45 seconds for chat or 15 seconds for confirmation, outside the shorter AST-02 server deadlines. No conversation is persisted by the app.
requirements.qaFocus: Logout/switch, reference/comparison cleanup, late responses, token refresh, reset/unmount, bounded history, action retry

requirements.acceptance: Assistant history may include zero to three unique ordered productIds per assistant entry, each a nonblank trimmed string of at most 100 characters; user entries may not supply this field. Invalid retained references return 400. For free-text follow-ups the server freshly reloads the most recent nonempty reference list, supplies catalog facts and original positions to the model, and explicitly marks removed IDs unavailable without shifting positions. Recognized reference questions resolve first/second/third/last or one unambiguous product name against original positions and answer current catalog facts without a model call. Ambiguous multi-card questions ask which product; a removed reference never shifts to another. Browser-supplied names/prices/options are never authoritative. References outside the retained 12-message window are forgotten.
requirements.qaFocus: Second-one follow-up, changed price/options, removed first item, duplicate/oversized references, fresh-read failure, bounded-history loss

requirements.acceptance: Chat sends the storefront display currency and rate. Missing display defaults to INR/1; only INR/1 or USD with a finite positive rate up to 1000 is accepted, otherwise 400. Currency/rate are presentation input, never purchase-price authority. Budget tools default to display currency; explicit priceCurrency INR/USD overrides it and conversion to catalog INR happens once on the server. Stored budgets retain their explicit INR/USD denomination across storefront display changes. USD filters require an available USD display rate, otherwise request an INR budget. Comparison differences use the same display conversion and disclose sub-unit differences instead of reporting a zero-price saving. Cards, cart summaries and suggestions follow display currency; stored/proposed/confirmed prices stay INR. Display rounds to whole units; numeric budget filtering uses unrounded conversion.
requirements.qaFocus: INR/USD card/prose/suggestions, explicit rupees under USD, zero/invalid rate, unavailable USD rate, exact budget boundary, unchanged INR confirmation

requirements.acceptance: Cards show category/optional brand, configured sizes/disabled unavailable sizes, selectable colors under checkout rules and optional server matchReason as escaped text. Chat thumbnails use shared versioned demo-photo mapping and complete-photo contain framing with no hover or legacy zoom. Known old contact-sheet references resolve to high-resolution standalone photos. The old first-row-only pixel regression now checks alias resolution with distinct synthetic legacy/clean images, plus an actual enhanced cargo preview. Unknown and existing original photo URLs pass through without heuristic cropping. Compare renders the AST-13 factual table and selects two/three unique products in selection order; a fourth is blocked and Clear resets. Find similar/Compare submit validated keyless interactions; Review bag addition requires configured options and integer quantity 1–10, proposes through AST-05 and never mutates before Confirm. Missing products/options/stock use safe notices. Interactions share limits/deadlines; retry preserves selected action.
requirements.qaFocus: Factual explanation, pixel-level first-row-only crop, real cargo asset preview, hover/reduced-motion/standalone regression, mobile controls, compare bounds, keyless similar, required options, no premature add

requirements.acceptance: Assistant opening/closing, incoming messages, loading dots, hover/selection and confirmation feedback use scoped CSS motion. Closing immediately makes the panel inert/hidden to assistive technology and removes it after 180 ms; reopening cancels pending removal. Reduced motion disables animations/transitions and uses immediate scrolling/closure. The panel fits 320px/390px mobile and desktop viewports; VisualViewport resize/scroll updates height/keyboard offset while retaining a non-modal layout. Composer grows with text up to 128px, then scrolls. Ordinary new content follows the bottom only while the reader is near it; a new comparison opens at its answer start while following is active; scrolling earlier replies preserves that position and offers Latest message. Sending or Latest message resumes following. Empty welcome starts at the top and has no Latest message control.
requirements.qaFocus: Motion preference, inert close/quick reopen, 320/390px bounds, simulated keyboard viewport, multiline growth/Shift+Enter, reader position and resume; real-device keyboard checks remain separate

requirements.acceptance: answerProductQuestion validates product ID and overview/material/care/fit/measurements/features/price/availability topic, freshly reloads catalog facts, and renders bounded deterministic text. getProduct also offers a factual overview from its current snapshot. Relevant authored compositionCare/details/measurements/description excerpts are explicitly attributed to the catalog; fields with instruction/HTML/URL markers are rejected. Material/fit hints from names are labelled as hints, never verified full composition or fit measurements. Missing topics remain Not listed/unknown, including care and unsupported features; water resistance is not upgraded to waterproofing. Photos/prices cannot establish comfort, durability or a universal best item. Query routing and vocabulary are finite; actual catalog truth and live provider topic selection remain unverified.
requirements.qaFocus: Material percentages, care negation, fit/measurements/features, malicious fields, name-only hints, absent data, fresh ordinal questions, no invented facts

requirements.acceptance: compareProducts and Compare selected accept two or three unique IDs, reload one current catalog snapshot, preserve selected order and refuse a missing selection without substituting older cards. Replies include optional structured comparison products/rows. Comparison replies open at the start of the answer when following is active, with compact product-page links instead of duplicate full cards; ordered references remain intact. Accessible horizontally scrollable tables show price, material, fit, care, options and stock, with category/measurement rows when informative and requested size/maximum-budget matches when active. Narrative gives a real price difference and one supported catalog attribute difference; sub-unit differences disclose display precision. Missing attributes remain Not listed and name hints keep their qualification. Recognized free-text comparisons use ordered current references/ordinals; ambiguous one-product comparisons ask for selection. No overall quality/comfort winner or review evidence is invented.
requirements.qaFocus: 2/3/duplicate/removed bounds, selected order, fresh prices, INR/USD/decimal gaps, missing attributes, size/budget rows, mobile scroll/sticky labels, keyboard and escaped data

requirements.acceptance: Conversation-only preferences track query/category, men/women audience, min/max budget and currency, color, size, supported material/fit, stock choice and up to six unique exclusions per color/material/fit list. API accepts validated optional state: query <=200 chars, category <=80, size <=30, other strings <=40, finite budgets 0..100000000, valid INR/USD/bools/enums or explicit null removals; invalid shape/keys/ranges give 400. Common English user refinements update visible chips; factual questions/comparisons do not become filters. Product-family switches clear size/material/fit and category while retaining other choices. Searches/related actions enforce active constraints over conflicting model arguments; exclusions cover listed evidence only. With client state, preferences survive the 12-message history window; legacy clients derive them from retained user history. Clear preferences keeps chat but removes filters; a subsequent refinement without a product asks what to search. New conversation, reload and identity changes forget memory; same-account refresh preserves it. No localStorage preference profile, database conversation or cross-device memory is created. Current state may be sent to the model even when its original message left recent history. Finite parsing/real-provider evaluation remain G-26.
requirements.qaFocus: Follow-up budget/color/size/material/audience, denomination preservation, null removals, negative terms, family switch, history-window loss, invalid API state, clear/retry/account/reset and no persistent storage

requirements.acceptance: Customer-owned data/admin actions shall enforce ownership/authority server-side or in RLS. Checkout/stock/catalog RPCs deny browser execution; catalog routes verify signed admin identity and use service role, with restrictive table/storage write guards in migration. Current inspector checks these contracts. Applied live permissions, remaining review workflow and other role acceptance still require verification.
requirements.qaFocus: Forged identities, public/customer write denial, service-only RPCs, applied migrations, live cross-role checks

requirements.acceptance: Service-role, per-admin password hashes, signing/rate-limit secrets, mail and test secrets stay server-side; QA utilities stay blocked in production. Production admin sessions use a separate signing secret and secure cookie attributes. Live environment/secret provisioning and MFA are unverified.
requirements.qaFocus: Client bundle/network/log exposure, production guards, secret separation/rotation, MFA gap

requirements.acceptance: Failed services shall show actionable feedback, preserve recoverable user state and avoid false success/partial inventory writes; fallback browsing must be distinguishable from working commerce in acceptance evidence.
requirements.qaFocus: Offline/timeout/DB/upload/provider/storage errors, retry, pending product navigation with exact destination and browser/server timing correlation

requirements.acceptance: Agree and verify responsive support at 375px mobile, 768px tablet and 1440px desktop, with no clipped essential controls; proposed browsers are current Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Assistant-specific 320px/390px and keyboard viewport behavior follows AST-11; Chromium emulation does not establish all-device support.
requirements.qaFocus: Touch/hover differences, drawers, tables, horizontal scroll, assistant keyboard/viewport emulation versus real devices

requirements.acceptance: Proposed accessibility target is WCAG 2.2 AA; assess keyboard operation, meaningful labels, focus placement/trapping/restoration, contrast, announcements and reduced motion. Storefront shell supplies one main landmark, with listing/detail/search/favorites/checkout/history/privacy using div containers to avoid nested main elements; newsletter has an explicit field label/description. Assistant close is immediately inert and reduced-motion preference disables its animated feedback. Scoped landmark/label/motion checks do not prove conformance.
requirements.qaFocus: One nonnested main, labelled preview, assistant inert close/focus/reduced motion, full keyboard/screen-reader/contrast audits, modal focus

requirements.acceptance: Agree measurable performance targets and dataset/network conditions before benchmarking; evaluate initial rendering, campaign-media weight, large catalogs and admin full-dataset reads. No current SLA is supplied.
requirements.qaFocus: Representative load, slow network, long lists, image sizes

requirements.acceptance: User-facing claims shall match demo capability; storefront denies fulfillment/support/newsletter delivery and admin order values are labelled demo, excluding cancelled orders; approved-only rating metrics and unsized low stock are corrected. Settings connection label and live restock concurrency verification remain open. Transaction locks require live multi-session verification.
requirements.qaFocus: Demo copy, metric definitions, settings label, live permissions/concurrency, retained limits

requirements.acceptance: Admin login, checkout, review creation/upload, restock subscription and shopping assistant shall use one atomic production database rate-limit counter across instances; missing shared configuration/RPC fails closed with 503.
